profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Delta Air Lines
profile.summary: Software Engineer experienced and excited about developing JavaScript applications with a focus in AWS(RDS) and database structures. Co-Creator of StratosDB, an AWS RDS developer tool for testing schema and query performance of SQL databases.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Used Angular to create a clean, component-based architecture for increased efficiency, reusable components, and maintainability with TypeScript
- Utilized GraphQL to enable declarative data fetching in order to consolidate multiple data queries into a single request and to avoid  over-fetching or under-fetching
- Utlized DynamoDB to procure a scalable and server-less database to fetch real-time data and to use global secondary indexes to enable fast and efficient access patterns
- Enhanced web infrastructure to improve performance, streamline processes, and efficiently collaborate with backend engineers and data engineers
- Implemented TDD and CI/CD practices in every step of development to quickly detect errors and to ensure product integrity, functionality, and scalability
- Used NextJS to build an intuitive UI and to create reusable components to dynamically render data, to keep code DRY, and to ensure reliability and predictability of state
- Imported Angular Material and Material UI to develop visually appealing prototypes and to deliver it to the business quickly in order to move the project into production

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
- Accomplished UI/UX best practices such as clarity, simplicity, and feedback to fulfill design specifications from the business in conjunction with seamless rendering
- Reduced cyclomatic complexity for aircraft seat map application to capitalize on reusable code and to increase efficiency in development and testing
- Leveraged AEM to manage and organize digital assets and to streamline workflows
- Used Sass to increase CSAT scores in post-purchase aircraft seat map application by 5% within three sprints by developing a responsive and intuitive user interface
- Utilized Jenkins to facilitate continuous integration and delivery between several teams to accelerate development with automated build and testing system

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented AWS/RDS to leverage cost-efficiency, reduce locally stored data, and
to capitalize on RDS data management tools such as backup, recovery, and security
- Architected Node.js backend server to handle requests asynchronously by taking
advantage of the non-blocking I/O and event loop
- Used React to create reusable components to dynamically render data, to keep code
DRY, and to ensure reliability and predictability of state with unidirectional data flow
- Implemented TypeScript to avoid runtime errors by incorporating static typing and
to reduce time spent on debugging by ensuring consistency and predictability
- Accomplished UI/UX best practices such as clarity, simplicity, and feedback to fulfill design specifications in conjunction with user accessibility and seamless rendering
- Used Webpack for future scalability, maintainability and faster load times to utilize hot module reloading, ES6+ transpilation for developer packages, and using minification and uglification features to decrease bundled file size
- Procured a relational SQL database within the AWS RDS instance to secure and prevent the degradation of the user’s tethered data to safely conduct native performance testing on targeted query requests in an isolated environment

positions.title: CentSybal | Budgeting App
positions.description:
- Harnessed React Context API and React Hooks to centralize state management and to establish a unidirectional data flow to ensure predictability, reliability of state at all times, and to bypass the need for an external state management library
- Integrated responsive React frontend with event-driven rendering to efficiently utilize browser resources to prevent unnecessary rerendering of components

positions.title: AXL Dev | Debugging Search tool
positions.description:
- Applied Redux-thunk in order to allow asynchronous API calls in action creators and to dispatch outputs of each thunk to result in seamless async control flow and to ensure the execution of actions before events are dispatched to reducers
- Leveraged React Router to conditionally render appropriate navigational components to decrease server calls and to increase  application load speed
- Imported Material UI to minimize time spent on stylizing components and to implement best practices for UI design such as consistency across different devices
- Implemented Bcrypt authentication to integrate salted, uni-directional hashing to prevent rainbow table attacks and to deter brute force attacks
- Deployed SQL database to efficiently leverage native PostgresQL features to efficiently shape and return large volumes of relational data in single queries without the need for additional server processing

positions.title: Pair/a\dice | Pair Programming Matching App
positions.description:
- Integrated Jest test-suites for TDD to push the team to define behaviors pre-implementation and ensure product integrity, functionality, and scalability
- Established Node.js/Express server to efficiently handle HTTP/API requests to myriad endpoints by using the middleware design pattern to leverage the power and scale of Node.js event loop and the scalability of large request volume
- Implemented WebSockets to enable interaction between multiple web browsers to facilitate real-time data transfer to and from the server to enable a low-latency, bi-directional pair-programming experience and to avoid HTTP request overhead
